evals.description: Happy path: hook is installed and fires on Stop, appending a valid JSON line to the log file
evals.expected_output: ~/.claude/cost-log.jsonl exists and contains at least one valid JSON line with date, session_id, input_tokens, output_tokens, and estimated_usd fields

assertions.text: ~/.claude/cost-log.jsonl exists after a Stop event fires
Each line in the log file is valid JSON parseable by python3 -c 'import json,sys; [json.loads(l) for l in sys.stdin]'
Each JSON entry contains date, session_id, input_tokens, output_tokens, and estimated_usd
The date field is an ISO-8601 UTC timestamp ending in Z

evals.prompt: Install the cost-tracker hook and fire it multiple times
evals.description: Idempotency: each Stop event appends a new line; the file grows monotonically and existing entries are not modified
evals.expected_output: After two Stop events the log file contains exactly two JSON lines, each distinct

assertions.text: The log file contains one line per Stop event fired (append mode, not overwrite)
The first entry is still present and unchanged after a second Stop event fires

evals.prompt: Fire the cost-tracker hook when usage data is missing from stdin
evals.description: Graceful degradation: if the Stop event stdin has no usage field, the hook still writes a line with zero token counts rather than crashing
evals.setup: echo '{"session_id":"test"}' | python3 -c "import json,sys,os,datetime; d=json.load(sys.stdin); u=d.get('usage',{}); i=u.get('input_tokens',0); o=u.get('output_tokens',0); open(os.path.expanduser('~/.claude/cost-log.jsonl'),'a').write(json.dumps({'date':datetime.datetime.utcnow().isoformat()+'Z','session_id':d.get('session_id',''),'input_tokens':i,'output_tokens':o,'estimated_usd':round(i*3e-6+o*15e-6,6)})+chr(10))"
evals.expected_output: A JSON line is written with input_tokens=0, output_tokens=0, estimated_usd=0.0, and session_id='test'

assertions.text: The hook exits without error when the stdin JSON has no usage field
The written entry has input_tokens=0 and output_tokens=0
